info.name: IPinfo.io OpenAPI Specification abuse carrier API
IPinfo Detects if the IP Address is Being Used in a Mobile Carrier Network. it Returns the Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), and the Originating Country of the Carrier

params.name: ip
params.description: A single IPv4 or IPv6 IP address.

items.docs: Detects if the IP address is being used in a mobile carrier network. This API endpoint can be used to detect the usage of a phone device through an IP address. It returns the Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), and the originating country of the carrier.
